receipt.code_identity: source_sha256 is authoritative; code_revision is optional context
receipt.oracle_contract: pi^t(start), fixed graph/start, no requested-depth token
receipt.selection: seeded sample using item/time/oracle equality and endpoint own-head correctness only
receipt.external_input: same fixed graph/start/embedding for every pair and replay
receipt.trace_indexing: full_states[t] is after loop t; full_states[0] is the all-zero initial state

primary.name: conditional_continuation_disagreement
primary.aggregation: unweighted mean over iid generated items with a defined endpoint-gated score
primary.value_repetition: independent draws can share the same permutation value

item_aggregation.uncertainty: descriptive only; caller defines sampling units, never overlapping visit pairs

pooled_future_diagnostics.pair_cell_definition: agreement means all H labels agree; a correct side means its complete H-step sequence is correct
pooled_future_diagnostics.step_cell_definition: each cell concerns one pair at one future offset
pooled_future_diagnostics.orientation: donor=t is earlier; receiver=u is later
